json.justification: A workable spot is visible on the adjacent wall to the right of the meter area, along the wall shown in photos 12-14. It provides about 3 ft of wall width, appears to have roughly 5+ ft of open clearance in front, and is away from the gas meter/regulator/piping by selecting a location several feet down the adjacent wall. The route from the electric meter shown in photo 11 can be supported along the building wall around the outside corner to this spot and is estimated under 16 ft. Ground is mulch/landscaping and appears workable, but rocks/vegetation at the foundation would likely need to be moved or trimmed.
